description: Maps MIDI control changes and notes onto the parameters of any modules, with pickup modes, note mapping, slew, input scaling and MIDI feedback to the controller.
notes: nothing responds until a MIDI device is picked on the display at the top, a slot is clicked, a parameter of any module is clicked, and the MIDI control or key is then moved.
the MEM, CTX, CLK and FINE expanders go in a row immediately to the right, in any order, and their settings appear on this module's own context menu.
menu: Input mode for CC — on a mapping slot's own right-click menu: Direct, Pickup (snap), Pickup (jump), Toggle, Toggle + Value, Snapped or Snapped (short/long).
Pickup (snap) — applies a control only once its previous value came within 3% of the parameter; Pickup (jump) also requires the new value to be within 7% of it, so big jumps are ignored.
Input mode for notes — on a mapping slot's own right-click menu: Momentary, Momentary + Velocity, Toggle, Toggle + Velocity, Snapped or Snapped (short/long).
Map module (left) — binds every parameter of the module on the left, offering Clear first or Keep MIDI assignments; Map module (select) and Map parameters by selection bind chosen ones.
Mode — Operating applies incoming MIDI to the parameters; Locate and indicate instead centres the mapped module on screen and flashes its indicator.
14-bit — on a mapping slot's own right-click menu, pairs a control change below 32 with the one 32 above it, raising that slot's resolution from 0-127 to 0-16383.
Slew-limiting, Low and High — on a mapping slot's own right-click menu, smoothing the incoming value and scaling the range it drives, with Presets Default, Inverted, Lower 50% and Upper 50%.
Re-send MIDI feedback — Now sends every mapped value back to the controller at once, and Periodically repeats that twice a second.
MIDI Input and MIDI Output — pick the driver, device and channel the module reads from and sends feedback to.
Precision — applies incoming MIDI at the sample rate, or at an eighth, a sixty-fourth or a two hundred and fifty-sixth of it, for less CPU.
Preset load — Ignore MIDI devices keeps the current device when a preset is loaded, and Clear mapping slots empties the slots first.
Import MIDI-MAP preset — reads a preset file saved from VCV MIDI-MAP and turns it into mappings here.
User interface — holds Text scrolling, Lock mapping slots, Status overlay, and the mapping indicator settings Hide, a colour picker and Reset color.
Clear all mappings — empties every mapping slot.
Clear MIDI assignment, Custom label and Send note on, velocity 0 — on a mapping slot's own right-click menu.
